title: Sync direction, timing and conflicts with linked platforms
question: For each linked platform, which data flows which way, how often, and who wins when both sides change? Should a new design version in the other platform update the Track3D design automatically or only notify admins?
context: Procore and Autodesk designs update automatically (INTG-REQ-011) while the Fieldwire PRD says notify and don't update (INTG-REQ-014). Fieldwire timing is 15 minutes, daily and immediate in different places (INTG-REQ-017).
